mathematics.assertion_tested: On the actual 321-mass FRZ1 halo grid, compare unscaled exact-law cold mass, form-B normalized/capped cold mass, reference cold mass, FZS1/JNT2 joined mass and patch charge at the prescribed settled radius. Verify separate conservation and force-law residuals and the common-r200 analytic benchmark.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: IEEE float64 numerical evaluation; analytic dimensionless benchmark independently evaluated in SI
mathematics.conventions: Halo masses Msun/h, comoving radii Mpc/h, physical R_set kpc=r_com*1000/[h(1+z)]; a0_com=a0_phys/(1+z)^2 after km/s/Mpc conversion; equation residual g^2/[gN(a0+g)]-1. FRZ1 Bar includes retained baryons only in cluster branch.
inputs: Actual FRZ1 321 masses log10 M200m=8..16; no mass subsampling
FZS1 FLD1 interpolated radii, galaxy Mb=(1-FB)Mta/Xsh, cluster Mb_fold=FB*M200c
JNT2 main-mode speed split, no fitted boundary changes

bounds.radial_grid: original 1600 log-radius points plus zero, junction, and layout nodes

non_claims: No action-derived transition, stability, fit, spectra, hydrodynamics or observational pass
No identification of retained Mb with stellar mass
No claim that cluster non-Bar reservoir is pure cosmic cold charge
No claim that XJ1 exact-B junction is exact raw standing-law profile when B already includes caps, remnant or precollapsed terms
No proof that crossing speed follows from a global or truncated budget
